protocol: DEV labels (vid_QD_1suWFNKo; dev only, used to calibrate the YOLO box -> ground-point offset; never scored as held-out). Same schema and protocol as labels_units_vid_uVf1EUszTIM.json: frames chosen as the busiest in-match frames per match (>= 8 detections, two per match, >= 450 frames apart; detector counts used for selection only), each labelled by eye blind to the detector on a render with only the 18x32 detector tile grid, then on 4x zoom crops with tile-centre and tile-boundary lines; no detector boxes or side-car output were looked at. tile = continuous detector-grid ground point (x 0..17, y 0..31 from our King side, tile centres at integers, as common.ref_to_tile). Troops: feet. Flyers: bottom of the body. Buildings: footprint centre. ref = tile_to_ref(tile) in 549x976 ref px. Classes are detector class names; -ev1/-hero distinct; 'unknown' = class unreadable. Flags: swarm, fly, bld, occ, spell, tower, river, deploy, formq, sideq, spl (spell area/projectile, excluded), gpq (ground point not read from pixels: placed 1.0 row below the HP badge in a dense overlap; excluded from the calibration fit). Labelled 2026-11-18 by four parallel by-eye passes.
